verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a public REST API v2 with official SDKs in six languages, an interactive Job Builder, and a credit-free sandbox. It also documents scoped API keys, OAuth 2.0, rate limiting with Retry-After, and real-time Socket API updates. A probe confirmed a live llms.txt pointing to the API documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving jobs through the API (beyond confirming the docs exist).
